body:
Someone's want keeps arriving in disguises that almost parse.

They feel the parasocial pull, rerun the dream with new casting, narrate somebody else's life with suspicious energy, and each clue is slightly wrong for the last theory.

With Neptune quincunx Lilith, people costume the material faster than they can decode it, and the appetite keeps sending itself back on stage under new names.

So they revise every interpretation a week later.

The theme may take months to name, but the disguises repeat, and repetition is the want signing its work.
